text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Your birthday text arrived the second the 
clock struck midnight♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a relief♪ It arrived safely, 
then. Ehehe, although when I looked back 
at it later, it seems I wrote "Happi 
Birthdae" instead.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I heard that lately it's trendy to send a 
'Happy Birthday' text right at midnight, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Since Tarumae-chan was kind enough to 
teach me how to "text", I thought I'd give 
it my best shot.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I felt so super warm and cozy inside my 
bed♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If it makes you that happy, it was well 
worth sending it♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... To celebrate, I made... a 
whole bunch of haskap berry preserves... 
so... ...*yaaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute-san? You look kinda sleepy, are 
you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm totally fine! It's just... I'm 
usually not awake until midnight, so... 
*yawn*... Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute-saaan!? Please don't push 
yourself just to send a birthday 
message~?!
